new.title: Walk across the Roman Taşköprü at dusk
new.desc: The Stone Bridge over the Seyhan River is a Roman-era crossing, attributed to Emperor Justinian, and is often called one of the oldest bridges still in use. Vehicles were banned in 2007 and it is now pedestrian-only.
new.tip: Cross on foot toward the Sabancı Merkez Camii for the skyline view at sunset. It is a short walk from the old town.
new.q: Taşköprü, Tepebağ, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: See the six minarets of Sabancı Merkez Camii
new.desc: Opened in 1998 on the west bank of the Seyhan, this mosque holds about 28,500 worshippers and has six 99-metre minarets, one for each of the 99 names of God. It is among the largest mosques in Türkiye.
new.tip: Dress modestly and avoid prayer times. The best photos are from Taşköprü or Merkez Park across the river.
new.q: Sabancı Merkez Camii, Reşatbey, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Visit the Ulu Cami and its Ramazanoğlu complex
new.desc: The Great Mosque was begun under Ramazanoğlu Halil Bey in the 16th century and enlarged in 1541, mixing Seljuk, Mamluk and Ottoman features. The külliye includes a medrese and a türbe.
new.tip: Ask the caretaker if the courtyard is open outside prayer times. It is a few minutes' walk from the clock tower.
new.q: Ulu Cami, Kızılay Caddesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: See the 1495 Ramazanoğlu Mansion beside the Ulu Cami
new.desc: Within the Ulu Cami complex, the Ramazanoğlu Hall (konak) dates from 1495 and is described as the oldest residential building in Adana. It is a rare surviving piece of the Ramazanoğulları beylik period.
new.tip: Combine it with the Ulu Cami and the Büyük Saat. Check opening status at the gate, as restoration is frequent.
new.q: Ramazanoğlu Konağı, Kızılay Caddesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Meet the Büyük Saat clock tower in the old town
new.desc: The 32-metre brick and cut-stone Great Clock Tower was built in 1881-82 and anchors the old centre. It is surrounded by small shops and vendors, and the Kazancılar bazaar starts a few steps away.
new.tip: Come early for the liver breakfast shops around it, or at dusk when the lanes fill up.
new.q: Büyük Saat, Sarıyakup, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Look at the Crusader portal of Yağ Camii
new.desc: Yağ Camii was built as a Crusader church dedicated to Saint Jacques and was converted into a mosque in 1501. It is still in use, and the carved entrance door is the highlight.
new.tip: Visit outside prayer times and look up at the gate. It sits near the old bazaar streets.
new.q: Yağ Camii, Ali Münif Yeğenağa Caddesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: See the Bebekli Kilise (St Paul's Church) in Tepebağ
new.desc: An Italian Catholic basilica built between 1880 and 1890, it is nicknamed Bebekli (with a baby) for the 2.5-metre bronze Virgin Mary statue on its roof. It stands on Çakmak Caddesi in the old Tepebağ quarter.
new.tip: Ask about visiting hours at the door as services are limited. Pair it with the Tepebağ mansions nearby.
new.q: Aziz Paul Kilisesi, Çakmak Caddesi, Tepebağ, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Step into the Atatürk House Museum in an Ottoman mansion
new.desc: The 19th-century mansion built for Suphi Paşa of the Ramazanoğulları family hosted Atatürk during his visits to Adana. It opened as a museum in 1981, reopened in 2003 after the 1998 earthquake, and shows photos and war-era objects.
new.tip: Entry is free. Plan on 30 minutes; the Cinema Museum is next door.
new.q: Atatürk Evi Müzesi, Seyhan Caddesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Browse the Adana Cinema Museum in an old Adana house
new.desc: Opened in 2011 in a renewed old Adana house, the museum honours Turkish cinema with a focus on directors, actors and producers from the city.
new.tip: Sits close to the Atatürk House on Seyhan Caddesi. Check hours before you go.
new.q: Adana Sinema Müzesi, Seyhan Caddesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Explore the Kuruköprü Monument Museum and Adana House
new.desc: The restored building opened in 2017 as the Kuruköprü Monument Museum and Traditional Adana House. It held the city's ethnography collection from 1983 to 2008 and shows how a traditional Adana home was arranged.
new.tip: Combine it with the Kuruköprü şalgam and börek shops nearby.
new.q: Kuruköprü Anıt Müzesi ve Geleneksel Adana Evi, Kuruköprü, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: See the Achilles sarcophagus at the Adana Museum Complex
new.desc: The Archaeology Museum, founded in 1924, moved into the huge new complex in the former Milli Mensucat textile factory (built 1907) and reopened there in 2017. Highlights include the Achilles Sarcophagus (170-190 AD) and Hittite pieces.
new.tip: Allow two hours; the agriculture, industry and city sections share the former factory. It is west of the centre, so take a taxi or bus.
new.q: Adana Arkeoloji Müzesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Learn Anatolia's coffee culture at the Kahve Evi Müzesi
new.desc: Seyhan Municipality opened the Coffee House Museum in the Tepebağ quarter in January 2024. It tells about 200 years of coffee history and drew nearly 50,000 visitors in two years. Entry is free.
new.tip: Open daily 08:00-17:00. Combine it with the Tepebağ houses and Taşköprü.
new.q: Kahve Evi Müzesi, Tepebağ, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Wander the Tepebağ mound and its old houses
new.desc: Tepebağ Höyüğü is Adana's oldest settlement mound, with roughly 8,000 years of habitation, and is topped by Ottoman-era houses beside the Taşköprü. Many of the mansions still await restoration.
new.tip: Walk up from Taşköprü in the morning light. Respect the occupied houses.
new.q: Tepebağ Höyüğü, Tepebağ, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: See the 1912 Adana railway station
new.desc: The present station on İstasyon Meydanı opened in 1912 on the Adana-Mersin line of the Ottoman railway era. It is the city's main rail gateway.
new.tip: Look at the façade from the square. Trains run to Mersin and across Anatolia.
new.q: Adana Garı, İstasyon Meydanı, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: See the Seyhan Dam and its turquoise lake
new.desc: The Seyhan Dam was completed in 1956 for power and flood control, creating the lake north of the city. The turquoise reservoir is lined by lakeside cafés and paths.
new.tip: Drive up Adnan Menderes Bulvarı at sunset. A car or taxi is needed.
new.q: Seyhan Barajı, Çukurova, Adana

new.title: Eat satır-minced kebap at Kebapçı Mesut, open since 1921
new.desc: Kebapçı Mesut in Kuruköprü is a historic kebap house serving traditional satır-minced Adana kebap since 1921, with beyti and külbastı on the menu.
new.tip: Order the Adana kebap with onion-sumac salad and şalgam.
new.q: Kebapçı Mesut, Karacaoğlan Caddesi, Kocavezir, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Eat külbastı with yayık ayran at Yeşil Kapı
new.desc: Yeşil Kapı on Ordu Caddesi is known for kıyma and chicken külbastı, grilled onions and churned yayık ayran.
new.tip: Order külbastı with the roasted onions and yayık ayran.
new.q: Yeşil Kapı, Ordu Caddesi, Reşatbey, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Dine with live fasıl at Kazancılar near the Büyük Saat
new.desc: Kazancılar is a historic restaurant near the clock tower in Sarıyakup, known for evening fasıl music, mezes and fruit.
new.tip: Reserve for the evening, when the fasıl starts.
new.q: Kazancılar, 6. Sokak, Sarıyakup, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Eat ciğer şiş at Memet Usta beside the Büyük Saat
new.desc: Tarihi Büyüksaat Ciğercisi Memet Usta sits beside the clock tower and is open 24 hours for liver skewers and offal plates.
new.tip: Come for a liver breakfast, or late at night when it is still open.
new.q: Tarihi Büyüksaat Ciğercisi Memet Usta, 23002. Sokak, Sarıyakup, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Try şırdan after midnight at Şırdancı Bedo
new.desc: Şırdancı Bedo on Karacaoğlan Caddesi serves şırdan (stuffed sheep stomach) and soups until about 04:00.
new.tip: Order şırdan with a squeeze of lemon and cumin.
new.q: Şırdancı Bedo, Karacaoğlan Caddesi, Kocavezir, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Drink cold şalgam at Kuruköprü Şalgam ve Vişnecisi
new.desc: Kuruköprü Şalgam ve Vişnecisi on İnönü Caddesi serves şalgam (fermented purple carrot and turnip juice) and sour cherry juice.
new.tip: Choose acılı (hot) or acısız (mild) şalgam.
new.q: Kuruköprü Şalgam ve Vişnecisi, İnönü Caddesi, Kuruköprü, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Eat halka tatlısı and künefe at Gönül Kardeşler
new.desc: Gönül Kardeşler has been a tatlıcı since 1975, known for pistachio halka tatlısı, taş kadayıf, künefe and baklava.
new.tip: Order the halka tatlısı and ask for hot künefe.
new.q: Gönül Kardeşler, Özler Caddesi, Kuruköprü, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Eat hot taş kadayıf under the old tree at Ağaçaltı
new.desc: Ağaçaltı Tatlıcısı is a roadside tatlıcı said to have stood under the same tree for about 80 years, selling hot taş kadayıf, halka and tulumba.
new.tip: Check the address on a map before going as sources differ.
new.q: Ağaçaltı Tatlıcısı, Özler Caddesi, Kuruköprü, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Order su böreği at Eski Mavi Köşe, open since 1973
new.desc: Eski Mavi Köşe Börek in Kuruköprü has served butter su böreği with cheese, minced meat and potato fillings since 1973.
new.tip: Go for breakfast and ask for the buttery cheese su böreği.
new.q: Eski Mavi Köşe Börek, Kuruköprü Mahallesi, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Order banana milk and a Yengen toast at Kazım Büfe
new.desc: Kazım Büfe on Toros Caddesi is known for its banana milk (muzlu süt) and toast stuffed with kaşar, sucuk and tomato (Yengen tostu).
new.tip: Order the muzlu süt with the toast.
new.q: Kazım Büfe, Toros Caddesi, Cemalpaşa, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Buy tahin helva and cezerye at Hacı Ahmet Şahin
new.desc: Helvanın Mucidi Hacı Ahmet Şahin sells tahini helva, lokum, cezerye (candied carrot with nuts) and other sweets in the old town.
new.tip: Buy cezerye for gifts.
new.q: Helvanın Mucidi Hacı Ahmet Şahin, 23040. Sokak, Sarıyakup, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Eat charcoal ribs at Kaburgacı Yaşar Usta
new.desc: Kaburgacı Yaşar Usta on Karataş Bulvarı serves ribs from the charcoal grill and kaburga with minced meat.
new.tip: Order the grilled kaburga.
new.q: Kaburgacı Yaşar Usta, Karataş Bulvarı, Sinanpaşa, Yüreğir, Adana

new.title: Have lamb stew and baked rice pudding at Bankalar Lokantası
new.desc: Bankalar Lokantası in Tepebağ is an esnaf lokantası serving stews and lamb dishes, plus fırın sütlaç.
new.tip: Come at lunch for the daily stews.
new.q: Bankalar Lokantası, 27047 Sokak, Tepebağ, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Stroll Merkez Park along both banks of the Seyhan
new.desc: Merkez Park is Adana's large riverside park, a weekend picnic and walking spot with paths on both banks and views of the Sabancı mosque.
new.tip: Go in the evening when it is cooler.
new.q: Merkez Park, Seyhan Nehri, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Browse the Kazancılar bazaar behind the Büyük Saat
new.desc: Kazancılar Çarşısı is the old bazaar near the clock tower, where a few coppersmiths and tinsmiths still work.
new.tip: Visit in the morning when shops are open.
new.q: Kazancılar Çarşısı, Sarıyakup, Seyhan, Adana

new.title: Join the Orange Blossom Carnival in April
new.desc: The International Orange Blossom Carnival is a street carnival with parades, a water parade on the Seyhan, a public run and concerts. The 14th edition ran 1-5 April 2026.
new.tip: Check the program, as dates shift slightly each year.
new.q: Atatürk Parkı, Seyhan, Adana
